ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.02 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across ~98% of the visible field with a single high-contrast white focal blob localized at the proximal junction of the lobes (median notch).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth equivalent to ~15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with irregular peaks (3-5 pixels in amplitude) along the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe exhibits smoother, lower-frequency variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical upward convex curve; left lobe exhibits a steeper vertical sweep compared to the more horizontal right lobe trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete cluster of ~8-12 high-contrast white circular pixel groups (1-3 pixels in diameter) localized on the distal-lateral edge of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-aligned white linear streaks detected on the mid-section of the right fluke lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical accumulation of epibionts (barnacles) on the terminal tip of the right lobe; blunt, irregular margin at the apex of the left lobe suggesting minor past trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized white pigmentation patch at the notch base is the primary identifying high-contrast marker.
